Mid-Continent Instruments and Avionics provides instruments, avionics, and power solutions to the global aerospace community. The Software Certification Engineer will support safety-critical software design, verification, testing, and certification for avionics, power electronics, battery systems, microcontrollers, and FPGA-based systems.
Computer Software
Responsibilities
Create and review design data throughout the software qualification lifecycle
Apply safety-critical software development and verification methods
Create plans, requirements, design standards, coding standards, change tracking, and verification documentation
Perform formal and functional verification activities
Test and troubleshoot prototype and certified software on target hardware
Work with lab bench equipment and other tools for debugging and analysis
Design embedded software for microcontroller-based systems
Develop PC-based applications for verification and manufacturing
Support software design using current tools, development environments, and documentation methods
Prototype and execute test programs to verify compliance with applicable performance, regulatory, and quality requirements
Provide engineering and technical support for avionics, power electronics, battery systems, and related technologies
Verify complex microcontroller and FPGA designs for functional and structural coverage
Support safety-critical software design and certification activities
